ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - Impersonate Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the Impersonate tool. Which can be used to manipulate tokens on a Windows computers remotely (PsExec/WmiExec) or interactively

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*impersonate\\\.exe.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ list\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ exec\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ adduser\\ .*"))) OR (process_hash = RGX(".*MD5\\=9520714AB576B0ED01D1513691377D01.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*SHA256\\=E81CC96E2118DC4FBFE5BAD1604E0AC7681960143E2101E1A024D52264BB0A8A.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=0A358FFC1697B7A07D0E817AC740DF62.*"))
